'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Geoff Dearing DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-combatreadiness-pre.gif|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' CRCBMKYA
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
